description: Remove Mongoose and dead dependencies, delete Mongoose model files, migrate file storage to Supabase Storage, and run the final validation pass (Steps H, I, J). Depends on FEAT-003 (all services must be migrated). This FEAT is independent of FEAT-001/002/003 in the sense that those must be fully complete first — do not start until FEAT-003 verification passes.
steps: Step H1 — Remove Mongoose packages: Run `npm uninstall mongoose mongodb sequelize sqlite3` in Backend/. Verify Backend/package.json no longer lists them.

Step H2 — Verify no lingering Mongoose references: Search all files under Backend/src/ for 'require(\"mongoose\")' or 'require(\'mongoose\')'. Search for 'require(\"../models' or 'require(\'../models'. Fix any remaining references found.

Step H3 — Delete Mongoose model files: Delete the entire Backend/src/models/ directory. These 15 files are now dead code: clinic.model.js, user.model.js, patient.model.js, appointment.model.js, doctor-availability.model.js, clinical-record.model.js, dental-finding.model.js, prescription.model.js, invoice.model.js, payment.model.js, file.model.js, ai-report.model.js, notification.model.js, audit-log.model.js, treatment-category.model.js.

Step I1 — Create Supabase Storage bucket: Ensure the 'xrays' bucket exists in Supabase Storage. Add startup code in Backend/src/config/supabase.js or a new Backend/src/config/storage.js that calls `supabase.storage.createBucket('xrays', { public: false, allowedMimeTypes: ['image/*'], fileSizeLimit: '10MB' })` — this is idempotent (does nothing if bucket exists).

Step I2 — Migrate file upload in ai.service.js: After callMlService() returns a valid result, upload the file buffer to Supabase Storage instead of relying on disk storage: read the file from disk using fs.readFileSync(file.path), call `supabase.storage.from('xrays').upload(`${patientId}/${file.filename}`, fileBuffer, { contentType: file.mimetype, upsert: false })`, store the returned `data.path` as storage_key in fileDb.create(). After successful upload, delete the local file with fs.unlinkSync(file.path) (or fs.unlink in a non-blocking manner).

Step I3 — Update signed URL generation in getAiReportsByPatient(): Replace the hardcoded `/uploads/${r.fileId.storageKey}` image path with a Supabase signed URL: `const { data: signedData } = await supabase.storage.from('xrays').createSignedUrl(storageKey, 3600)`. Return `image: signedData?.signedUrl || null` in the response shape.
Step I4 — Update reviewAiReport() to also return signed URL if needed: When reviewAiReport returns the report, optionally include a signed URL for the associated file.

Step J — Full validation: Start the server and test all 15 endpoints listed in phase3-plan.md Section 10. Record the results in this FEAT's findings field. Confirm: (1) no 401 bypass — GET /api/patients without token returns 401. (2) Auth works — login returns JWT. (3) Patient CRUD works. (4) Appointment booking and conflict detection works. (5) Payment and invoice creation works. (6) Clinical record creation with dental_chart JSONB works. (7) Dashboard stats return correct data. (8) Reminders endpoint returns processedCount. (9) Treatment category CRUD works. (10) All toFrontendShape() return identical fields to pre-migration.
acceptance_criteria: npm list mongoose in Backend/ returns '(empty)' — mongoose is gone.
node index.js starts without any module-not-found errors.
POST /api/ai/upload (with ML service running) stores file in Supabase Storage and returns signed URL in the image field.
All 15 endpoint checks from phase3-plan.md Section 10 pass.
No references to mongoose, ObjectId, .populate(), or Mongoose model patterns anywhere in Backend/src/.
verification: cd Backend && npm list mongoose — must output '(empty)' or show mongoose is not in the dependency tree
node -e "require('./src/models/clinic.model')" from Backend/ — must throw MODULE_NOT_FOUND (models directory deleted)
node index.js from Backend/ — server starts cleanly, no errors

Full endpoint sweep: POST /api/auth/login, GET /api/patients (with token), POST /api/patients, GET /api/appointments, POST /api/appointments, GET /api/payments, POST /api/payments, GET /api/clinical/:id, POST /api/clinical, GET /api/categories, GET /api/stats/dashboard, POST /api/notifications/send-reminders — all return expected shapes without errors
